shape_save_confirm.title: Shape editor: Save asks first (summary)
dialogs:
confirm: Save dungeon room "2nd floor, left: Ossiud room"?

   25 points, area ≈ 1722 × 1722, 11 monsters inside (lvl 47-49), levels 47-49

Used by every party (the leader hunts only inside this room outline). Marked as edited by hand, so the generator tools keep it. A copy of the file goes to Scripts/data/history/.

Bots: a party leader loads dungeon_rooms.json once per swarm.js (re)load (dungeonRooms() cache) — he hunts in the new outline after the next reload / deploy. The escape map of members (safe spots, room outlines) re-reads it every 5 min. swarm.js does not check a room's "enabled" flag yet.
